candidates.name: Solitary Fibrous Tumor/Hemangiopericytoma
support_spans: Histopathological examination demonstrated spindle cells forming masses with branching ectatic vasculature, focal collagenous regions, and up to 20 mitoses per ten high-power fields.

Immunohistochemical studies showed strong immunoreactivity for CD31, CD99, and Fli-1, with scattered S100-positive cells, and negative staining for CD34, EMA, desmin, muscle-specific actin, and Bcl-2.
candidates.why: The patient's histopathological examination and immunohistochemical studies are consistent with Solitary Fibrous Tumor/Hemangiopericytoma.

candidates.name: Cavernous Angioma
support_spans: Contrast-enhanced brain MRI revealed a left tentorial extra-axial enhancing mass with adjacent parenchymal hemorrhage, suggesting a cavernous angioma.
contradict_spans: Histopathological examination demonstrated spindle cells forming masses with branching ectatic vasculature, focal collagenous regions, and up to 20 mitoses per ten high-power fields.
candidates.why: The patient's MRI suggested a cavernous angioma, but the histopathological examination did not support this diagnosis.
